meta.description: Tests recognition of automatic private IP addressing.

question.text: A Windows endpoint cannot contact its DHCP server and self-assigns an IPv4 address. Which TWO observations are consistent with APIPA? Select two.
options: The address is in the 169.254.0.0/16 range
The endpoint may have trouble reaching devices beyond its local link
The address is always a public address assigned by an ISP
The address proves that DNS is functioning correctly
correctAnswers: The address is in the 169.254.0.0/16 range
The endpoint may have trouble reaching devices beyond its local link
